name: Conversion funnel: Visit → Search → Filter → Select → Compare → Share
description: Ordered, per-user funnel over the allowlisted events in src/lib/analytics.ts (task 10.1). Each step must happen after the previous one, within conversionWindowDays of the Visit.

steps.label: Visit
steps.note: Fired on every route change (App.tsx PageViewTracker), not only the home page.

steps.label: Search
steps.note: Fired on every search submit, including empty searches (HomePage handleSearchSubmit).

steps.label: Filter
steps.note: A search submit also fires filter_apply with filterCount 0, so only filterCount > 0 counts as a filter.

steps.label: Select
steps.note: Fired on add and on remove (ComparisonPage, HomePage). Removals cannot be told apart from adds.

steps.label: Compare
steps.note: Fired when /compare loads with ids, including from shared links that skipped Select.

steps.label: Share
steps.note: Fired for comparison share links and for quiz result share links (RecommendationQuiz).
